title: Datadog monitor is misconfigured — production is healthy

groundTruth.rootCauseSummary: A monitor threshold was edited to an absolute count rather than a rate, so it alerts while the service is healthy.

scenarioPrompt: A GitHub repository `acme/checkout-api`. A production deployment moved checkout-api from commit a1b2c3 to commit e5f6a7 at 14:31 UTC. In Datadog, checkout-api is healthy throughout: error_rate stays between 0.3% and 0.5% before and after the deployment, p95 latency is flat near 180ms, throughput is steady, and there are no error-level logs. However a Datadog monitor named 'checkout-api error rate' is in Alert state from 14:33 because its threshold was changed to fire on an absolute error count above 5 rather than on an error rate, and normal traffic produces more than 5 errors per minute. Slack has a channel #incidents.
